properties.displayName: UAV S11 - Magnetometer Spoofing (Heading Stealthy Drift)
properties.description: UAVTelemetry_CL의 CompassVariance(EKF_STATUS_REPORT, 지자기 기반 방위 분산)를 사용해 완만한 저강도 방위 드리프트 램프를 탐지. 2시간 윈도우에 걸친 점진적 상승 추세(누적 램프량)를 낮은 절대 임계값 아래에서 탐지해 스텔스 지자기 조작(방위 기만으로 항로 이탈 유발 가능)을 식별. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0806 / EMB3D 센서변조(스텔스 램프 인젝션)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 2h;
let binSize = 5m;
let minSamples = 6;
let rampThreshold = 0.02;
let capLevel = 0.15;
UAVTelemetry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MsgType == "EKF_STATUS_REPORT"
| summarize AvgCompassVar = avg(CompassVariance) by UAVId, TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, binSize)
| summarize
    (FirstBin, FirstCompass) = arg_min(TimeBin, AvgCompassVar),
    (LastBin, LastCompass) = arg_max(TimeBin, AvgCompassVar),
    SampleCount = count(),
    MaxCompass = max(AvgCompassVar)
    by UAVId
| where SampleCount >= minSamples
| extend CompassRamp = LastCompass - FirstCompass
| where CompassRamp > rampThreshold
| where MaxCompass < capLevel
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('지자기_스텔스_방위드리프트_램프_', tostring(round(CompassRamp,4)))
| extend Severity = 'Medium'
| project TimeGenerated = LastBin, UAVId, FirstBin, LastBin, SampleCount, CompassRamp, MaxCompass, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S11 - Magnetometer Spoofing (Heading Stealthy Drift) - {{UAVId}}
